source_policy: Reuse current catalog byte/MD5/XML validation and source-bound bootstrap comparison. New cache container is an original local format, not new official protocol fields.

format.revision: LE uint64 restricted to JS safe integer1..MAX_SAFE_INTEGER-1
format.flags: offset16 encoding utf8=0/gb18030=1; offset17 bareAmp0/1; reserved18..19 zero
format.lengths: offset20/24 LE uint32 game/region byte lengths each1..1048576
format.checksum: offset28..43 MD5 of header0..27 followed by raw game/region bytes; unkeyed corruption check, not authenticity
format.payload: game then region at44, no trailing bytes

store: Explicit profile, two fixed managed files under native USER_DATA_PATH. Select newest complete validated record; same revision different records conflict. Write inactive slot/readback, same JS context exclusion and expectedRevision check. No deletion or claimed native atomic transaction.
write_uncertainty: After native write is issued, timeout/cancel/error cannot prove noncommit: return CACHE_COMMIT_UNKNOWN, retain buffer and guard until callback, no retry/rollback. Actual device/durability/multiworker semantics unverified.
host: Optional catalogCacheProfile, no automatic IO; explicit check/restore/save. Keep raw pair private, clear input/consent/selection on restore, preserve configured decoding/endpoint gates, compare raw bytes on next source-bound refresh.
validation: Native API-shaped bounded filesystem including asynchronous/late write
Actual host/Page/build without DOM and independent current peer
native_gate: Prior IDE_SERVICE_PORT_EXPLICITLY_DISABLED remains, no replay/settings change
parser_limits: Each raw file<=1MiB and container<=2097196B, but all existing XML256KiB characters/nodes/fields/depth limits still apply.
remaining: Resource/patch ports, native update transaction, official authenticated acceptance
